help_telegram:
*Available commands:*

`!help` - Show this help message
`!text` - Switch to text responses
`!voice` - Switch to voice responses
`!chats` - List your recent conversations
`!set <id> [platform]` - Switch to a conversation
`!prompt list` - List available prompts
`!prompt <name|id>` - Switch prompt
`!new` - Start a new conversation
`!unlink` - Unlink Telegram from your account

help_whatsapp:
*Available commands:*

!help - Show this help message
!text - Switch to text response mode
!voice - Switch to voice response mode
!chats - List your recent conversations
!set <id> [platform] - Switch to a conversation
!prompt list - List available prompts
!prompt <name or id> - Switch to a different prompt
!new - Start a new conversation
processing_failed_whatsapp: Sorry, an error occurred while processing your message. Please try again later.
voice_fallback: Sorry, there was a problem generating the voice message. I will send you the message as text.
rate_limit_whatsapp: You're sending too many messages. Please wait a moment before sending more.
documents_unsupported: Sorry, document attachments are not supported yet. Please send text or images.
media_unsupported: Sorry, this media type ({media_type}) is not supported. Please send text, images, or audio.
no_conversations: No conversations yet. Send a message to start one!
invalid_mode: Invalid mode. Use voice or text.
mode_invalid_platform: Invalid platform. Use whatsapp or telegram.
telegram_not_linked: Telegram is not linked to your account. Link it first from Telegram.
phone_verification: Your phone number must be verified first. Check your account settings.
phone_required: No phone number on your account. Set it in your account settings first.
remove_devices: Remove external device access before assigning this conversation to WhatsApp or Telegram.
conversation_locked: Conversation #{id} is locked. Use !new to start a fresh one.
mode_failed: Could not change response mode. Please try again.
help_application:
!new - New conversation
!chats - Conversations in this context
!set <id> - Resume a conversation
!prompt list - Available assistants
!prompt <alias> - Switch assistant
!entry - Return to entry assistant
!text / !voice - Response mode
application_link: To access this application, send !link followed by your invitation code.
application_connected: Application connected. You can now send a message.
application_command_unavailable: Command unavailable in this application. Send !help for available commands.
whatsapp_unknown: This phone number is not registered on the platform. Please contact the administrator or sign up to get started.
